summary:
Product and Growth Analytics Leader with 5+ years of experience driving revenue, retention, and operational
efficiency through data-driven decision making. Proven track record of building experimentation frameworks,
scalable data systems, and AI-powered analytics solutions. Strong cross-functional leader with experience in
gaming, fintech, and AI-driven platforms.

skills._method: flashtext_skills_section | fuzzy(experimentation→A/B Testing(100%), cross-functional→Cross-functional Collaboration(100%), fintech→Fintech(100%))

bullets: Implemented an automated voice telephone scheduler for appliance repair using Deepgram Speech-to- Text, Elevenlabs Text-to-Speech, and OpenAI GPT-4o LLM. Achieved a 48% conversion rate, with an average cost of $0.16 per call, $0.06 per minute, and 3-second latency.
Developed a natural language analytics system that converts plain English queries to SQL, interprets results with LLMs, and delivers visual and textual insights in Python.
Achieved three promotions in two years for consistent performance and exceptional contributions.
Awarded multiple Analyst of the Month, recognizing the highest 10% performance within the team.

Led a team to implement user segmentation for targeted coupon and cashback offers using SQL, Python, and Redis, based on gameplay and transaction metrics with automated daily updates. Introduced par- allelization via Airflow to improve efficiency and modularization to reduce resources required for new segment creation. During the modification of the TDS and GST law in the gaming industry, increased revenue by 7% month-over-month through targeted cash rebates with minimal impact on contribu- tion margin.

Collaborated with marketing, product, and strategy teams to identify key metrics for A/B testing. Devel- oped a configurable Python script to automate result tracking, reducing manual hours. Communicated industry-standard practices to the Leadership Team, leading to the introduction of experimentation for significant changes in the platform. Currently running an average of 15 experiments on monthly basis.

Defined critical metrics such as refund rate, next game registration percentage, and zero-fill tournament ratio highly correlated with ARPUD (Average Revenue per user day) and next-day retention to track game-wise liquidity. Implemented biweekly Tournament Scheduling rules, reducing refund rates by ∼28%, enhancing next game retention by ∼16%, and minimizing lobby wait times by ∼ 50%, and launch of higher entry fee tournaments with combined improvement of ∼18% in Platform Revenue.

Streamlined ETL pipeline with SQL and Python, reducing run-time by 90% to Reconcile Transactions (1M Daily) between internal Data, Payment Gateway reports, and Bank Settlement Records; Published a Tableau Dashboard for visuals insights and daily alerts for mismatch transactions.

Identified that removing the Quick format led to significant drop in platform revenue, based on pre-post analysis. Achieved Monthly Revenue Growth of ∼3% validated through A/B testing by relaunching the quick Ludo format contributing ∼40% of platform revenue (ARR ∼Rs 2000 Crore).
Crafted All India Gaming Federation supported skill-chance metrics to manage legal risk for the real-money gaming industry using Pearson’s correlation, the chi-square test, and hypothesis testing.
Implemented a cashback fraud detection system, using Graph Theory's Community Detection Algorithm to identify fraudulent groups, resulting in a contribution margin increase of ∼21%.
Validated pricing of varied OTC (Over the Counter) Financial Instruments belonging to Equity, FX, Interest Rates, and Commodity asset classes using standardized Hedges and Black-Scholes model.
Developed an automated R script for statistical validation of linear regression models (assumption and hypothesis testing), reducing manual effort for CCAR reporting by ∼20%.
